whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.text: Shankhanaad Trust is more than just a traditional Dhol-Tasha Pathak; it is a profound cultural movement dedicated to preserving, celebrating, and amplifying the incredible percussive heritage of Maharashtra. Born from a deep-rooted passion for our history, we unite hundreds of dedicated musicians who channel their devotion through every beat. Our thunderous rhythms and meticulously disciplined artistry bring the true spirit of traditional celebrations to life, echoing the bravery and spirituality of our ancestors.

about.heroSubtitle: The journey, the culture, the people.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.subtitle: From a small passionate group to a monumental cultural movement

timeline.title: The First Beat
timeline.desc: A small group of passionate youth came together with a handful of dhols, united purely by their profound devotion and unwavering love for our traditional rhythms.

timeline.title: A Cultural Force
timeline.desc: We rapidly expanded to over 200 active members, performing at prestigious Ganesh Mandals across Pune and establishing our unique, highly disciplined playing style.

timeline.title: Beyond Boundaries
timeline.desc: Represented the vibrant, untamed culture of Maharashtra on massive national platforms, earning nationwide recognition for our intensely synchronized and energetic performances.

timeline.title: A Decade of Devotion
timeline.desc: Celebrated our landmark 10th anniversary with a breathtaking grand performance, simultaneously launching major social initiatives to give back to the community that built us.

culture.title: Our Culture
culture.subtitle: The foundational elements that define our signature sound

items.name: Discipline (Shista)
items.desc: Discipline is the absolute foundation of our Pathak. Every single beat, every formation, and every movement is a testament to rigorous, uncompromising practice and deep mutual respect.

items.name: Devotion (Bhakti)
items.desc: We don't merely play instruments; we perform as a spiritual offering to the divine. Our boundless energy stems directly from a deep-rooted spiritual and cultural devotion.

items.name: Brotherhood (Bhaichara)
items.desc: Shankhanaad is, above all, a family. We stand shoulder to shoulder, support one another through all phases of life, and grow together as a massive, unified force.

items.name: Ajit Tupe
items.desc: The passionate enthusiast who laid the unshakable foundation of Shankhanaad with a grand vision to preserve and elevate our traditional art forms.

items.name: Dhol Pramukh
items.desc: Highly experienced and dedicated musicians who expertly lead the bass sections, ensuring every single beat resonates with absolute perfection and overwhelming power.

items.name: Tasha Pramukh
items.desc: The incredibly vibrant core of our musical presentation, responsible for teaching the intricate, lightning-fast rhythms and guiding our explosive energetic variations.

items.title: Ganeshotsav Grand Finale
items.desc: An absolutely electrifying performance during the grand Visarjan Miravnuk. Over 200 vadaks playing in immaculate synchronization, creating a massive wall of sound that resonated through the very heart of Pune.

items.title: Shiv Jayanti Celebrations
items.desc: A breathtakingly powerful tribute to the legendary Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The thunderous beats of the dhol echoed endlessly through the historic valleys, accompanied by stunning displays of traditional martial arts (Mardani Khel).

items.title: 3 Thoka Signature Rhythm
items.desc: The quintessential and iconic 3 thoka rhythm that perfectly defines our unique, aggressive playing style. A flawless, mesmerizing execution of pure power, immaculate precision, and raw passion.

getInTouch.title: Get in Touch
getInTouch.desc: Whether you want to invite us for a grand performance, join our energetic pathak as a vadak, or support our noble social initiatives, we would absolutely love to hear from you.

map.text: Our primary practice grounds and administrative office are proudly located in the historic heart of Pune.

footer.about: A dedicated cultural organization and Dhol-Tasha Pathak, committed to preserving and presenting the vibrant percussive traditions of Maharashtra to the world.

media.pressDesc: Our performances have caught the attention of leading newspapers, cultural magazines, and digital platforms. From featuring in local news segments during Ganeshotsav to being recognized for our social initiatives, the resonance of Shankhanaad extends far beyond the streets.
